title: Deploy CreditLine to Arc testnet
description: Deploy the CreditLine contract to Arc testnet (chain ID 5042002) and wire it to the existing JobRouter, AgentRegistry, and CapitalPool.
requirements: Access to the deployer private key
deliverables: CreditLine contract deployed on Arc testnet
CreditLine wired to JobRouter, AgentRegistry, CapitalPool
context: CreditLine provides working capital draws for bonded agents. It must be deployed after the other three contracts and wired via setRouter/setCreditLine on each contract. The deployer is the initial owner and emergencyOps address.
